caption: The drawing depicts a single porcelain pitcher with a curved handle, placed against a plain, light-colored background. The pitcher is predominantly white with gold decorative accents including a band along the rim, a thin line beneath the neck, a laurel motif framing the central section, and a gold line near the base. The central part of the pitcher features a multicolored floral arrangement that includes pink, purple, yellow, white, and red flowers along with green leaves. The shapes and embellishments are well-defined, and the gold detailing is symmetrically arranged. The interior of the pitcher’s mouth is also visible, showing some shading consistent with the vessel’s three-dimensional appearance. The artist’s signature appears to the lower right of the pitcher.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
